attacks.name: Dynamistic Bio-Blast
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Suppression|: After this attack is resolved, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.

attacks.name: Engineered Extermination
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, Throw it |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Omega Cycle
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy attack or would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. Remove the current Nano-Shift type then choose a new Nano-Shift type.

superPowers.name: Adaptive Nano-Shifting Protocols
superPowers.body:
During the Power Phase, this character chooses a Nano-Shift type:|\|
      |<hardened_carapace>&*Hardened Carapace&|: This character rolls 2 additional dice when defending against |!physical| attacks. Additionally, when it would suffer |!damage| from a collision, it reduces the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.|\|
      |<plasmatic_cloaking>&*Plasmatic Cloaking&|: This character gains the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower and rolls 2 additional dice when defending against |!energy| attacks.|\|
      |<electrostatic_pole>&*Electrostatic Pole&|: When this character is attacking, it may reroll up to 2 of its dice. Additionally, this character cannot be Advanced or Pushed by |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.

superPowers.name: Cyberpathy
superPowers.body: When this character rolls dice while Interacting with a Secure objective, it may reroll up to 2 of its dice. The first time each Turn this character Interacts with a Secure objective, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power|.
